messages:
Oncall Bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT alert — batch_queue_growth high on runtime-prod across r-s1/r-s2. Alert: batching.queue_len > 1200 for 3m. Paging #eng-oncall. thread: 1769005432
Alex B: got it, i'm on. looking at dashboards now. any initial customer impact flags? @jordan
Jordan T: seeing tail latencies spike 2-3x, QPS steady. suspect continuous-batching parameters expanded recently (auto-opt). top offenders are small-req streaming sessions causing batching to backlog.
Alex B: okay. runbook step 1: confirm whether batching window increased. checking config audit...
DeployBot: config-change detected by CI at 1768990000 — auto-batching-tuner: enabled, max_window_ms: 50 -> 200
Alex B: that's the culprit. tuner bumped max_window_ms to 200ms. that explains queue growth. we need to trade throughput for latency briefly.
Mira S: agree. propose quick mitigation: cap max_window_ms to 80ms and apply per-customer QPS cap for noisy customers. that'll reduce batch depth. thoughts?
Kevin L: +1. also suggest enabling early flush for streaming routes so single-token streams don't wait full window.
Jordan T: ok plan: 1) set max_window_ms=80, 2) set streaming.early_flush=true, 3) apply temp quota 10 qps to top noisy customer IDs. I can run the commands.
Alex B: do it. patch and roll only to r-s2 first (canary) then r-s1 if green.
Jordan T: running canary now.
Jordan T (paste): ```
# canary
redwoodctl runtime set-param --env prod --pool r-s2 --param continuous_batch.max_window_ms=80
redwoodctl runtime set-param --env prod --pool r-s2 --param streaming.early_flush=true
redwoodctl traffic set-quota --env prod --customer-id cust-482 --qps 10 --duration 30m
```
DeployBot: change accepted, deploying to r-s2. change id c-20260301-01
Oncall Bot: Monitoring metrics for change id c-20260301-01
Jordan T: canary looks good after 90s: queue_len r-s2 dropped 65%, p95 latency down 35%. no errors.
Alex B: roll to r-s1 then. Jordan, mirror the commands to r-s1. I'll watch logs and error budgets.
Jordan T: rolling to r-s1 now.
DeployBot: change id c-20260301-01 applied to r-s1. monitor link: https://console.redwood/changes/c-20260301-01
Mira S: metrics across prod show overall queue_len back within normal range. p99 improved but still slightly elevated for streaming long sessions.
Alex B: next step: keep the temporary quotas and early flush for 30m, then reassess. need to notify support teams and affected customers list.
Jordan T: compiling impacted customer list now — preliminary: cust-482 (rate-limited), cust-199 (spiky), cust-810 (stream heavy). sending to #support.
Alex B: thanks. also logging this mitigation in incident tracker. runbook tag: batching-window-mitigation.
Mira S: handing off to @Mira S for post-incident follow-up and postmortem. I'm going offline in 30m, will leave notes.
Mira S: acknowledged. I'll take ownership for follow-up and perf regression evaluation. assign postmortem to eng-runtime + prod-sre.
Alex B: final note: quick lessons — automatic tuner needs safeguard: cap absolute max and alert on rapid window jumps. please file an RFC/bug.
Jordan T: filed bug #INF-8274 referencing change id c-20260301-01. assign to runtime-tuner team.
Oncall Bot: INCIDENT status: mitigated -> monitoring. thread closed for active mitigation. last_message_ts: 1769005852
